parties: Lakshman Dharmapriya Perera Samaraweera Gunathilake v. Secretary, Ministry of Labour & Others Lakshman Dharmapriya Perera Samaraweera Gunathilake v. Secretary, Ministry of Labour & Others View More
keywords: Certiorari and Mandamus – Employment – Labour Tribunal award of Rs.900,000 – Employer company already subject to winding-up proceedings – Tribunal proceedings commenced/continued without leave of winding-up court – Lack of jurisdiction – Employee seeking enforcement through Labour Department – EPF dues – Statutory prohibition against proceedings against company after winding-up order/provisional liquidator – Suppression of material fact concerning commencement of winding-up – Writ relief unavailable. Deepali Wijesundera J. sat on the bench.
legistation: Constitution – Articles 140 and 143; Companies Act No. 17 of 1982 – section 264; Employees’ Provident Fund legislation as referred to in the judgment.
